name: Footer card pair

geometry.left: background surface.inverse, colour text.onInverse, radius radius.footerCard, padding 2.5em, flex:1, min-width 20rem
geometry.right: background surface.card, radius radius.footerCard, padding 2.5em, flex:1 0 auto, min-width 66.66%

responsive.le991: left card min-width 100% -> wraps to two full-width rows
responsive.le767: footer_row becomes column with 32px gap; the wordmark gets order:-1 and sits above the terms row
responsive.le479: left card padding 1.5em; link lists 50% wide

notes: Each card carries one absolutely-positioned clip-path blob (footer-shape-left olive on the left card, footer-shape-right peach on the right).
The right card's .footer_links-container is EMPTY on the homepage (a 0-height spacer) and holds three ul.footer_link-list columns on every other marketing route.
An empty zero-height div.container precedes div.container.cc-footer-container in the real DOM and is reproduced on purpose.
